summary: Found an oversell caused by per-line stock checking. A single cart with two lines sharing the WIDGET inventory item (OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3, 12 units against 10 stocked) completed successfully. In ensureInventoryLevels (packages/modules/inventory/src/services/inventory-module.ts), each reservation input is checked against the same pre-batch available_quantity, and the shared item's quantities are never summed. The result was an order holding 12 reserved WIDGET units against 10 stocked, failing no_oversell in 13 of 13 runs. reserved_matches_reservations passed, since the counter matches the live reservations. I did not explore the two-server process-local-lock or other causes within this budget.
